items.item_text: (6) Six months training in a clinical laboratory or (1) one year experience in a reference laboratory.

Assures that the rights of the patient/family are respected and maintained. Allows for privacy and modesty in the provision of care. Identifies self by name and title to patient/family. Establishes presence of consent prior to initiating specimen collection procedures.

Assures the consideration of therapeutic, diagnostic, and preventive measures in accordance with specimen collection procedures, including, but not limited to: infection control isolation patient procedures, intravenous fluid infusion, hyperbaric/dialysis patient preparations, diagnosis-related venous complications, emergency room trauma protocols, respiratory/cardiac arrest protocols, and behavioral health patient protocols.

Provides for the physical, psychosocial, and spiritual needs of the patient and family. Completes phlebotomy within required time frames. Correctly differentiates between normal/abnormal findings. Incorporates functional/developmental age into care: newborn, pediatric, adolescent, adult, and geriatric.

Demonstrates the ability to communicate effectively with healthcare providers respective to, but not limited to: correct tests ordered, patient identification wristbands, assistance with arterial line collection protocols, and point-of-care specimen requests.

Demonstrates the ability to safely and competently perform therapeutic/diagnostic phlebotomy procedures according to Medical Center policy and procedure, including, but not limited to: following patient identification protocols, documentation of collected specimens in nursing activity books, transportation of specimens to the laboratory (STAT, urgent, timed, and routine collection priorities), blood culture/therapeutic drug monitoring, skilled venipuncture and capillary puncture technique, collection of appropriate specimens (tube order of draw), proper labeling of specimens, and knowledge of specimen/test requirements.
Associates Other desired with science background
Other graduate from Medical Assistant School.
